caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a person standing upright on a rectangular gray pedestal, dressed in a short yellow tunic with fringe at the hem, yellow lace-up boots, and a multicolored cape with green, blue, and red sections draped over the shoulders. The person holds a long spear in the right hand and a rectangular sign in the left hand that reads "Cigars and Tobacco" in cursive script. The figure has medium brown skin, dark shoulder-length hair, and wears a yellow headband adorned with three large feathers in red, yellow, and blue colors. The background is plain and unadorned, with a slight yellowish tint.
title: Cigar Store Indian
